tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: Who Grideōs is: definition, legal entity, location, contact, people, applications, method and trust layer, with links.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Keyword search across grideos.com answers, pages and dispatches. Returns short passages with their URLs for citation.

tools.name: list_claims
tools.description: List the claims in the signed Grideōs facts ledger, optionally filtered by topic (identity, location, people, what, ironwall, programs, relationships, contact, machine-access, privacy, work). A superseded claim names the entry that replaced it.

tools.name: get_claim
tools.description: Return one ledger entry by ID (for example GRD-007) with its evidence links, status, hash and the hash of the previous entry.

tools.name: verify_claim
tools.description: Recompute a ledger entry's SHA-256 hash and chain link, and optionally compare a quoted claim text with the ledger text. Returns where to verify the Ed25519 signature independently.

tools.name: list_dispatches
tools.description: Dated Grideōs updates with titles, summaries and URLs, newest first.

tools.name: contact_info
tools.description: Email, office address and the URL of the brief form. This server cannot send messages.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_site, list_dispatches · Private data: get_company_profile, list_claims, contact_info · Public sink: contact_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_site, list_dispatches · Private data: get_company_profile, list_claims, contact_info · Public sink: contact_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
